subject: Digital Electronics
questionText:
A digital circuit is as given below:
input lines of the circuit are a1, b1 a0, b0 and output 
line is y. 
Then no. of combinations of input lines in which 
output y will be ‘1’is ___________. 
[MCQ]
explanation: Practice Question from Digital Electronics DPP-05 (FA, FS, Comparator, Mux).
